purpose: Correct transport declarations without deleting or weakening expected behavior. Original stable IDs and exact expected text remain native web cases. New linked IDs preserve distinct stateless service business outcomes; relatedCases identify already canonical outcomes where no additional service action exists. This is catalog accuracy, not passing coverage evidence.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Typed text validation rejects.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Typed date validation rejects.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: No field changes commit.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Scope validation rejects.
corrections.reason: Native choice lookup uses the current definition field and project scope. Options owned by another field/project cannot be selected; raw foreign option identifiers remain rejected by REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: No values commit.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Review action rejects invalid current context.
corrections.reason: The native review move selector loads only the issue assigned workflow. It cannot submit a foreign workflow transition identifier; that invalid current-context service boundary remains required on REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Review action rejects invalid current context.
corrections.reason: Native non-current transition context is History only and hides review actions. Sending vote/resubmit for such a transition remains a separate REST/MCP rejection boundary.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Validation rejects unnecessary new review context.
corrections.reason: Native approval action buttons render only for a current transition with required > 0. No unnecessary resubmit button is offered; the raw service request remains validated on REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Validation rejects.
corrections.reason: The native saved-search name input has maxlength 80 and cannot submit an overlong name by ordinary typing. The original greater-than-80 raw request rejection remains required on REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Issue must first return to unstarted stage.
corrections.reason: The native More actions menu renders Move to backlog only while the current stage category is todo. Started work cannot submit this fresh native action; raw REST/MCP validation remains unchanged. A stale todo editor instead exercises revision conflict.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Current author-only write rule rejects mutation.
corrections.reason: Native comment records expose Edit comment only when the current actor is the author. Administrators can read another author content and history but cannot invoke an edit through ordinary controls; direct author-only mutation rejection remains on REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Vote rejects and retained reporter decision does not count.
corrections.reason: The native approval context marks the reporter ineligible when reporter exclusion is enabled and therefore offers no vote action. Policy changes also change the review revision token, so a stale native request exercises context conflict; direct reporter-ineligible request rejection remains independently required on REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Assignment rejects atomically.
corrections.reason: The native label picker scopes lookup and existing issue draft to its fixed project. Label definitions cannot change owning project, so a foreign UUID cannot be selected or introduced through ordinary controls. The original atomic foreign-identifier assignment rejection remains required on REST/MCP.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: Accepted bytes are not appended twice.
corrections.reason: The native resumable uploader first reads the authoritative session after a lost chunk acknowledgement and skips committed offsets. Its ordinary retry does not resend that accepted chunk with its original reference; exact same-reference replay remains a REST/MCP operation boundary and the native resume outcome is preserved separately.

expectedBehaviorsPreserved: One committed asset is returned without duplicate publication.
corrections.reason: The native resumable uploader reads an already committed session and fetches its existing asset after a lost finalize acknowledgement. It does not resubmit the original finalize request in this reachable flow; exact finalize reference replay remains required on REST/MCP and committed-session native recovery is separately preserved.
